## Have you checked docs/?

The design is written down before it is built, so a fair number of ideas are already specified
and simply not built yet — cost per print, low-stock alerts, export, multi-printer support and
more all live in [docs/15 — Public Release](../../docs/15-public-release.md). If yours is one of
them, say so and add what your use of it would look like; a specified feature with a real user
behind it moves up the list.
